title: Caller, outside a tenant check (C154)
description: A signed-in person (role user; role account before they have a user, C157) or a machine client acting for itself (role client), checked on something that is not tenant data, such as their own user. A tenant is optional: a client may act within one, and a person may call from inside a workspace. If either tenant attribute is sent, both must be.

account_id.description: A signed-in person's Kratos account (their token's sub, C157); absent for a machine client.
